thread:
anya: quick heads-up — staging canary rolled to 10% about 20m ago and we're seeing a p95 regression on small-seq workloads, ~12% higher than stable. link: https://dash.redwood/internal/canary/2419 :eyes:

sam: saw that. p95 for short seqs went from 42ms -> 47ms in the recent window. tail look OK but need flame or perf diff. any config changes in this rollout? :thinking:

marta: no config changes from my side, model artefact is v2.1.0-quant. I triggered a few sample runs against the staging harness, attaching quick numbers below:
```
stable p95: 42.1ms
canary p95: 47.2ms
qps: 1200 (both)
kv cache hit: 88% -> 86%
cpu% on host: 72% -> 78%
```

devon: oncall-bot fired an automated pulse shortly after rollout: 
oncall-bot: [ALERT] canary/2419 p95_shortseq +11.8% over baseline, threshold 10% exceeded.

sam: that's > our 10% threshold for auto-hold. can we pause further rollout and collect kernel/user-space allocations + a few perf traces? I can run bisect if we have traces across builds.

anya: yep please hold. marta — can you snapshot two sample traces (stable vs canary) and upload to /tmp/canary-profiles/2419? also enable continuous sampling for the next 10 min. :thumbsup:

marta: copying commands I ran for the quick samples:
```bash
# sample harness run
./harness --profile --seq-type=short --qps=200 --model=v2.1.0-quant --out /tmp/canary-profiles/2419/canary.json
./harness --profile --seq-type=short --qps=200 --model=stable --out /tmp/canary-profiles/2419/stable.json
```
I uploaded both, + perf.data symlinks. sizes small, links: https://artifacts.redwood/canary/2419/{stable,canary}

devon: quick diff summary I ran locally — stack samples show more time in attention kernel on canary (~+7% wall-time) and a small uptick in memcpy churn. Might be quant kernel selection difference.

sam: ok good. if it's kernel selection we can try forcing the stable kernel set on the canary nodes and re-run. but for safety let's keep rollout at 10% (no further ramp) and mark this as HOLD until we get a clear mitigation.

anya: agreed. i'll flip the rollout to manual hold and notify infra to freeze canary scaling. Action items: marta collect full perf traces (in progress), devon run kernel-forcing experiment, sam to prepare rollback plan in case spike doesn't drop under 8% by EOD.

marta: started continuous perf sampling, ETA 8m. uploading debug logs now.

oncall-bot: [NOTE] canary/2419 rollout paused by anya at 2419876578 per auto-hold policy.

sam: thanks — i'll start a short A/B run with kernel pin and report back. if anyone sees errors in the harness logs ping here.

anya: thanks team. keep updates short in thread; we'll reconvene after the traces finish. :white_check_mark:
